technique_name: Choose two charismatic figures and describe how they are similar yet different.
description: Ruth Bader Ginsburg and Malala Yousafzai are both charismatic figures who have made a significant impact on society. Both are women who have utilized their voices on a global platform to spread a message of change, justice and courage. They have both achieved remarkable success in their respective fields despite difficult odds. However, they are also different in many ways.
